01 / ABOUT

A marketer by work.
A builder by instinct.

I like understanding why people pay attention, what makes them take action and how a good idea becomes a repeatable system.

“The interesting part of marketing is where creative instinct meets measurable outcomes.”

My experience sits across performance marketing, social media, media buying, lead generation, email marketing, video editing and automation. I enjoy moving between strategy and execution — from shaping an ad angle to looking at the numbers behind it.

I've worked with businesses and projects in home services, education, wellness, retreats and consumer brands. Each has taught me something different about positioning, audience behaviour and the details that make campaigns work.

Outside campaign work, I'm interested in building brands, exploring AI tools, creating content and finding smarter ways to get work done.
